title: market_snapshot (spec 1.1.7 and 1.1.8): Oodle's pre-open market-data pack, one ticker_snapshot per ticker per day plus a pack_index
description: PAPER ONLY. Read-only market data for the app (the app never fetches; Sol R6). Rules MD-01..MD-15 in market_data_rules.yaml (YAML wins over market_data_rules.md); the JSON Schema here is MD-03, the rest is checked by validate_market_snapshot.py. No personal or account fields: additionalProperties false everywhere. Spec 1.1.8: schema_version 1.1.8 documents use the *V118 defs and CatalystLog (catalysts.json); 1.1.7 documents use the unchanged 1.1.7 defs and validate exactly as before.

SourceRefV118.description: 1.1.8 source reference: origin = who originates the fact; origin_entity = which one (for origin issuer: the ticker symbol). Two references with the same (origin, origin_entity) are ONE source (MD-07); an issuer release on its IR site, GlobeNewswire, PR Newswire, Business Wire or gcs-web.com is origin issuer (MD-07-ORIGIN).

event_date.description: America/New_York calendar date; null only with status UNKNOWN (MD-15-UNKNOWN / -VALUE)

event_time.description: optional ISO 8601 date-time WITH a UTC offset (naive = MD-15-TIME-NAIVE); its NY date must equal event_date (MD-15-DATE). Absent or null = date-only

sources.description: CONFIRMED needs >= 2 sources whose (origin, origin_entity) differ (MD-15-UNCONFIRMED); a dated entry needs >= 1 (MD-15-UNSOURCED)

TickerContext.description: optional per-ticker context (one entry per ticker, MD-15-DUPLICATE)

prior_close.description: a sourced field (MD-06, MD-13; not MD-05: a prior close is not a live quote)

from.description: prior rating or target; null if none

to.description: new rating or target; null if none

date.description: not after the pack's NY date (MD-04-FUTURE)
